newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers firmer with active enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers firmer with active enquiries.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes moved higher with active enquiries on Wednesday to reflect the recent strength in the cargo market, traders said.

Continued firm cargo prices forced some shipowners, who have been unwilling to cover their requiremnets in the past few weeks, to consider covering their need, although many still felt that the support in the cargo market is artificial, traders said.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $103-$107 and 380-cst at above $100, around $2-$3 firmer from Tuesday's quotes. MDO and gasoil were at around $205 and $215 respectively.
